record.title: OCEL v2 RevOps current
record.body: R76 preserves two non-conflated economic object classes. RevenueFROMCustomer requires payer, causal capability, producer, value/amount metric, evidence root, attribution confidence and time window. RevenueFORCustomer requires beneficiary, causal capability, producer, customer process, value outcome, customer revenue outcome, proof, confidence, time window and retention/expansion evidence. The merged sensors expose missing fields and semantic conflation. Current live economic edges remain UNKNOWN because no independently admitted customer payment or customer-revenue proof was consumed in this run. Next action is evidence ingestion, not commercial actuation.
